channel.title: AI Pulse
channel.description: Daily AI intelligence: model releases, tools, research, industry news.

item.title: ZAYA1-8B: New Open Reasoning Model Trained on AMD Instinct GPUs
item.description: A new 1.8 billion-parameter open reasoning model, ZAYA1-8B, has been released, showcasing efficient performance and a significant shift in AI hardware utilization.

item.title: Hugging Face Unveils Open-Source App Store for Robotics
item.description: Hugging Face launched the Reachy Mini App Store, an open-source platform with over 200 community-built apps for robots. It democratizes robotics development, accelerating innovation.

item.title: Subquadratic Claims 1,000x AI Efficiency Breakthrough with SubQ Model
item.description: A Miami-based startup has emerged from stealth, claiming a revolutionary AI model that breaks free from long-standing mathematical constraints, promising unprecedented efficiency gains.

item.title: Microsoft Agent 365 Exits Preview, Offering Unified AI Governance
item.description: Microsoft's Agent 365, a unified control plane for managing AI agents across diverse platforms, has moved out of preview. This launch addresses the growing challenge of "shadow AI" in enterprises.

item.title: xAI Unveils Grok 4.3 with Aggressive Pricing and Advanced Voice Cloning
item.description: xAI has launched Grok 4.3, introducing a powerful voice cloning suite and an aggressively low price point. This release signals a strategic shift in the competitive AI model market.

item.title: xAI Launches Grok 4.3 with Voice Cloning and Aggressive Pricing
item.description: xAI has rolled out Grok 4.3, featuring a new voice cloning suite and a competitive pricing strategy. This release targets specialized brilliance and cost efficiency in the LLM market.

item.title: RunPod Flash: A New Open-Source Tool for Faster AI Development
item.description: RunPod has launched Flash, a new open-source Python tool designed to accelerate AI development by eliminating container overhead. It aims to streamline the AI-first cloud.

item.title: OpenAI Expands Cloud Reach, Ends Microsoft Exclusivity
item.description: A landmark shift in cloud AI sees OpenAI models become available beyond Microsoft Azure, as its exclusive partnership with Microsoft is restructured. This move signals a new phase in the cloud wars.

item.title: The Agent Economy: When AI Stops Answering and Starts Working
item.description: 2026 is the year AI agents stopped being demos. Real companies are now paying AI systems to complete multi-day tasks autonomously — and the economics are genuinely strange.

item.title: Google's Gemma 4: Open Weights Finally Reach the Frontier
item.description: Google has released Gemma 4, its most capable open-weights model yet — and for the first time, an open model from a major lab genuinely competes at the frontier.

item.title: GPT-5.4 vs. GLM-5.1: The Battle for Coding Supremacy
item.description: OpenAI's latest GPT-5.4 release faces an unexpected challenger: Zhipu AI's GLM-5.1, which has officially overtaken it in key coding benchmarks.

item.title: Claude Mythos: Anthropic’s Most Powerful Model (With a Catch)
item.description: Anthropic has confirmed Claude Mythos, a model so powerful it is currently locked behind a 50-company firewall.

item.title: OpenClaw v2026.4.9: Dreaming REM and Diary UI Overhaul
item.description: The latest OpenClaw release introduces ‘Dreaming’ capabilities with REM backfill and a significant security hardening overhaul.

item.title: The March 2026 AI Surge: 12 Models in 7 Days
item.description: March 2026 went down in history as the month that changed AI forever, with a record-breaking 12 model releases in a single week.

item.title: Vibe Coding: How AI Rewired the Way We Write Software
item.description: From Cursor to Claude Code to GitHub Copilot — the craft of software development fundamentally changed in 2025. Here's what vibe coding really means and where it's heading.

item.title: Claude 4 Unveiled: Anthropic's Most Powerful Model Family
item.description: Anthropic launches Claude 4 with Opus 4, Sonnet 4, and Haiku 4 — pushing the frontier of reasoning, coding, and multimodal capabilities to new heights.

item.title: OpenAI's o3: The Reasoning Model That Changes Everything
item.description: OpenAI's o3 achieves near-human performance on scientific and math benchmarks, making the AI safety community rethink timelines — and raising urgent questions about what comes next.

item.title: Gemini 2.0 Ultra: Google's Multimodal Masterstroke
item.description: Google's Gemini 2.0 Ultra brings native audio, video, and code understanding together in a single frontier model, challenging every benchmark GPT-4o and Claude hold.

item.title: Meta Releases Llama 4: Open Source Reaches the Frontier
item.description: Meta's Llama 4 family brings open-weight models to frontier performance levels, reshaping what's possible for developers building on local and self-hosted AI.

item.title: DeepSeek R1: The Chinese AI That Shocked Silicon Valley
item.description: DeepSeek's R1 model matched GPT-4 performance at a fraction of the cost, triggering a rethink of AI economics and a historic stock market selloff.
